added: A new Undo prompt setting in Settings › General chooses how long the Undo message stays on screen after you delete or change something: 6, 10, 20 or 30 seconds, or until you close it. It now stays for 10 seconds unless you choose otherwise.
The Undo message now stays on screen while you point at it with a mouse or move to its Undo button with the keyboard, and starts its time again when you move away.
changed: Deleting a venue, custom field, shorthand, dialect, custom theme, walkthrough snippet or matrix column now happens at once and offers Undo, like deleting a dance, instead of asking first with no way back.
Confirm before delete now covers every delete you can undo, including tags, authors and sources, not only dances and programs.
A delete that can't be undone, such as permanently deleting from Recently deleted or deleting one of your own Glossary entries, always asks first and says "This can't be undone."
Confirmations that remove, reset, replace or discard something now use the red delete-style button, and the one that replaces an existing dance from Import and edit says Replace instead of Continue.
